exact_statement: For rational, halting finite MDPs and all memoryless deterministic policies pi, pi', either ||v_pi-v_pi'||_1 = 0 or ||v_pi-v_pi'||_1 >= (2D)^(-2|A||S|) 2^(-2|S|).
assumptions: halting: every policy eventually reaches a terminal goal/reward state
D is the maximum row-wise LCM of reduced transition denominators
pass_condition: The symbolic denominator certificate is valid, complete finite-domain enumeration finds no positive gap below the per-MDP bound, the independent checker agrees, and the negative control is rejected.
fail_condition: Any assumption-satisfying policy pair has a strictly positive L1 gap below the bound, or either independent check disagrees.
